test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Let C be a circle with center O and PQ be the diameter of C. Let AB be a chord on C. If ∠QOB = 40°, ∠AOP = 80°, then find ∠AOB.
solution:
**Given:**

∠QOB = 40º

∠AOP = 80º

**Formula used:**

The sum of all angle on a straight line is 180º.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ee190b6a232f2803868fde3d4a741e2d79399257d32dd04b32f42a70452ccab.png] 

∠QOB = 40º

∠AOP = 80º

Since PQ is the diameter, 

Let ∠AOB = xº

∠AOB + ∠AOP + ∠QOB = 180º (sum of angles on a straight line)

⇒ x + 80º + 40º = 180º

⇒ x + 120º = 180º

⇒ x = 180º - 120º

⇒ x = 60º

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
